options.text: A clear connection and order through a shared edge
Guaranteed contrast between the different elements
options.misconception: confuses alignment with a difference in visual appearance

options.text: Automatic color harmony among the various items
options.misconception: mistakes positional order for relationships between colors

options.text: A stronger closure effect on each individual shape
options.misconception: misapplies figure completion to the placement of edges

questions.explanation: Alignment places elements on a common edge or axis, creating order and an implied connection. When items sit just off that shared line the layout looks accidental, and snapping them back to the alignment restores a clean, deliberate structure.
questions.hint: Think about what a common edge communicates to a viewer.
